text:
sara_csm: Heads-up on Freightly — onboarding has basically stalled this week. their admin reported 70% drop in active seats and procurement asked for a competitive pilot update. new CTO left last week, so decisioning is in flux. anyone from eng or SE who can join a 30m call?
priya_ae: ugh, thanks for the flag. do we know if it's usage or invoices? i pinged procurement earlier — they said they're 're-evaluating vendor list' and have a short pilot with competitor X.
marco_se: saw the alert this morning. logs show an AES-enabled integration started failing on certain webhook payloads around 03:00 UTC 3/10 — might have caused the activity dip for a subset of seats. i opened a debug session.
jamal_support: ticket #CS-7821 created. root-cause hypothesis: recent client-side library update + backoff misconfig. i put a hotfix patch to QA and scheduled a deploy to staging.
ops-bot: :warning: account-activity-alert freightly: seat_activity -70% over 7d, spike in 5xx errors 2026-03-10T03:02:14Z. linked ticket CS-7821.
sara_csm: thanks team. key asks from my side: 1) quick triage + rollback option if hotfix risky 2) a short enablement session for their new infra lead (they start Mon) 3) competitive note for Priya to share with procurement.
priya_ae: i can take the procurement note if we can provide an 'uptime + fix plan' and a one-off pro-bono dedicated support window for their pilot. that usually calms procurement.
marco_se: rollback path is ready — can flip to last stable container within 10m and route warm requests through it. if Jamal's QA looks good, we can do the staged rollback + canary today.
jamal_support: QA patch passed basic e2e. willing to run the canary and monitor metrics (latency, 5xx, kv-cache hit). i'll put alert hooks on the canary group.
sara_csm: perfect. i'll schedule a 30m call with Freightly's new infra lead and Priya for Thursday 10:00 PT. Priya — can you prepare a short competitive one-pager: what we fixed, proposed SLA gestures, and trial extension?
priya_ae: yep. i'll draft and share in this thread by EOD. include a small credit (1-month trial extension) and a dedicated onboarding slot.
marco_se: i'll be on the call to explain the rollback/canary tradeoffs and confirm timeline.
jamal_support: starting canary now. pushing monitor dashboard link: https://dash.internal/redwood/freightly/canary
sara_csm: action items consolidated: (a) Jamal — run canary + monitor (b) Marco — standby for rollback (c) Priya — competitive one-pager + credit proposal (d) Sara — schedule call + prep exec summary. i'll update CS notes and QBR doc.
priya_ae: shared draft note at https://docs.internal/redwood/sales/freightly-competitive-brief (will paste summary after edits).
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: CS-7821 canary status: initial 10k requests passed, 5xx at baseline. next check-in in 30m.
sara_csm: thanks all — let's regroup after the canary. if canary stays green we offer a 30-day trial extension and dedicated onboarding slot; if not, we escalate a rollback and exec outreach.
marco_se: noted. i'll keep a watch on the rollback window and have a script ready to run.
jamal_support: monitoring looks stable so far. will report back at +30m.
sara_csm: closing loop later today. :pray:
